patch.description: Moves the job into another project (or out of any).

delete.description: Removes the job and its workspace; exported files stay.

post.description: Past a review gate, and again from stopped or failed steps.
Run the steps whose input changed (stale) again.

409.description: Busy, or edits by hand need confirm

get.description: Newest first, each with the files it produced that are still kept.

post.description: An earlier run becomes the step's result again; the steps after it become stale.

get.description:
The file as an attachment named like the export; transcripts as .srt. inline: shown in the
browser instead (transcripts as plain text).

put.description:
Saves the editor's cues as an edit by hand: steps after it become stale. With the original next to
it (every cue has `source`), both are saved with the same cues (merges, splits, timings).

The request body is the file. Each upload gets a folder (pass the same `id` to put more files
in it); the job's results are exported into it too.

post.description: Show the file in Finder / the file manager.
Keep a 3–8s clip to clone a voice from; returns its path for the dub step's ref_audio.

Reads text (or a sentence of the subtitles) in the voice the dub step would use.
The text read is in the X-Preview-Text header, URL-encoded.

get.description:
{"type": "job", "job"} when a job or one of its tasks changed, {"type": "progress", "job_id", "task_id",
"done", "total"}, {"type": "log", "job_id", "task_id", "event"}, {"type": "deleted", "id"}.
The system logs of every attempt of the job with this trace id (or an error code / span id).
